title: Karyopharm's selinexor misses primary endpoint in Phase 3 endometrial cancer trial
snippet: Karyopharm Therapeutics announced that its Phase 3 XPORT-EC-042 trial did not meet its primary endpoint of progression-free survival. The company is reducing planned investment in endometrial cancer.
label: trial_failure

title: Angelman wings clipped by Ultragenyx phase III bust
snippet: The Aspire trial of apazunersen fell short of the primary endpoint, change from baseline in the Bayley-4 Cognitive raw score. Shares fell 44%.
label: trial_failure

title: Rhythm Pharmaceuticals' Phase 3 EMANATE trial falls short of primary goals
snippet: The Phase 3 EMANATE trial of setmelanotide did not meet the primary endpoints across its four substudies.
label: trial_failure

title: Theravance Biopharma Plummets As Phase 3 Study Falls Short
snippet: The CYPRESS study of ampreloxetine in multiple system atrophy missed its primary endpoint, and the company is winding down the ampreloxetine program.
label: trial_failure

title: Jazz Pharmaceuticals Phase 3 LAGOON Trial Fails To Meet Primary Endpoint Of Overall Survival
snippet: The LAGOON trial of lurbinectedin in small cell lung cancer did not meet its primary endpoint of overall survival.
label: trial_failure

title: Genmab misses primary endpoint in phase III study with epcoritamab
snippet: The EPCORE DLBCL-1 trial did not meet its primary endpoint of overall survival, though the secondary endpoint of progression-free survival was achieved.
label: trial_failure

title: Boehringer Ingelheim Axes MASH Pact With OSE After Disappointing Mid-Stage Data
snippet: Boehringer dropped its MASH program after an exploratory Phase 2 study did not demonstrate efficacy to support further development in this indication.
label: trial_failure

title: Immutep tanks as it discontinues 'efti' trial following futility analysis
snippet: The IDMC for the Phase 3 TACTI-004 trial of eftilagimod alfa in first-line non-small cell lung cancer recommended discontinuation after a planned interim futility analysis. Shares fell 88.6%.
label: trial_failure

title: Sanofi Abandons Phase 3 Trial of Neurology Drug Riliprubart
snippet: The MOBILIZE trial in CIDP was stopped early due to futility after an interim analysis. The independent data monitoring committee found no safety issues. The companion VITALIZE trial continues.
label: trial_failure

title: Arcus Biosciences And Gilead Discontinue Phase 3 STAR-221 Study In Cancer Due To Futility
snippet: Following an IDMC review of a pre-specified interim overall survival analysis, the domvanalimab-based combination did not improve overall survival relative to nivolumab plus chemotherapy in upper GI cancers.
label: trial_failure

title: Biogen Stops Part of an MS Trial; Merck Reports More Enflonsia Data
snippet: Biogen suspended the combination arm of an MS trial after interim analyses showed the added agent did not deliver the expected benefit and raised safety flags.
label: trial_failure

title: Patient Death Forces Partial Freeze on MacroGenics' Gynecologic Cancer Study
snippet: The FDA placed a partial clinical hold on the Phase 2 LINNET study of lorigerlimab after a treatment-related death. New enrollment is suspended; enrolled participants may continue treatment.
label: clinical_hold

title: Q32 Bio announces corporate restructuring to focus on bempikibart
snippet: Q32 Bio is ending its Phase 2 renal basket trial of ADX-097 to focus resources on bempikibart for alopecia areata, extending cash runway.
label: business_discontinuation

title: Aldeyra Cans RASP Asset, Brings Forward Two Others in Pipeline Shakeup
snippet: Aldeyra discontinued a Phase II asset even though it reported statistically significant liver function improvements, shifting to other candidates and extending its cash runway.
label: business_discontinuation

title: Bicycle Therapeutics Deprioritizes Key Program, Announces Workforce Reduction
snippet: Bicycle deprioritized zelenectide for urothelial cancer after regulatory feedback and is cutting about 30% of its workforce.
label: business_discontinuation

title: Aldeyra Therapeutics Receives Complete Response Letter for Reproxalap in Dry Eye Disease
snippet: The letter cited a lack of substantial evidence consisting of adequate and well-controlled investigations, and stated that inconsistency of study results raises serious concerns about the reliability of the data.
label: regulatory_rejection

title: Replimune's advanced melanoma drug rebuffed by FDA for second time
snippet: The FDA issued a second complete response letter for RP1 with nivolumab, maintaining its objection to the single-arm trial used to support the application.
label: regulatory_rejection

title: FDA Rejects Cytisinicline NDA for Now, Requests Manufacturing Resolution
snippet: The complete response letter stemmed from manufacturing issues at a former facility. No efficacy or safety concerns were identified; resubmission is planned for Q4 2026.
label: regulatory_rejection

title: Aquestive Therapeutics (AQST) stock: FDA rejects allergy treatment over packaging concerns
snippet: The complete response letter for Anaphylm centered on administration and labeling issues; the FDA did not question the drug's effectiveness.
label: regulatory_rejection

title: Belantamab Mafodotin In Plasmablastic Lymphoma & ALK+ Large B-Cell Lymphoma
snippet: Status: TERMINATED; Why stopped: The study was closed given lack of efficacy and plans to publish this negative study.; Sponsor: Jacob Soumerai, MD; Phase: PHASE2; Conditions: Relapsed Plasmablastic Lymphoma; Interventions: Belantamab Mafodotin
label: trial_failure

title: Registry record NCT03694015
snippet: Status: TERMINATED; Why stopped: A blinded futility analysis was conducted and demonstrated that even with full accrual, the primary endpoint was unlikely to be met as there was no difference in Radiation Induced Nausea and Vomiting-related Quality of Life between the arms.
label: trial_failure
